optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

professionalSummary.text: Experienced data pipeline engineer with a proven track record of maintaining build-event ingestion pipelines, optimizing daily aggregate jobs, and delivering measurable performance improvements in a developer tools platform environment.
professionalSummary.witness: The daily aggregate's completion time dropped from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after the incremental rewrite was released, measured over the following thirty days in the pipeline monitoring dashboard against the published baseline of 3 hours 40 minutes.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained build-event ingestion pipelines using Kafka consumers, implementing schema versioning to ensure backward compatibility with evolving event formats.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed daily aggregate jobs that consolidate build, test, and deployment events into per-repository tables for engineering dashboards.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated schema and job changes with dashboard and platform teams, ensuring alignment and documented responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored comprehensive lineage documentation for aggregate jobs, detailing source topics, incremental logic, known limitations, and hand-over conditions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, listing source topics, the incremental logic, the known limitation that late events beyond 48 hours were not re-aggregated, and the hand-over items for on-call.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Pipeline monitoring dashboard export showing daily completion times over sixty days, baseline line, and release marker, accompanied by lineage notes and job run identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the pipeline monitoring dashboard export (daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, release marker) and the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, with the job run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Kafka, event ingestion, schema versioning, data warehouse
